objective: Review post47 sensory evidence, define an interpretable next contrast and assess what is and is not established about stage4/5 feasibility.
exposure: 45/46/47 and the post47 sensory report are exposed. Own proposal recorded before a new ChatGPT reply. No blind confirmation or physiological validation claimed.

A.hypothesis: The identity and distribution of peripheral activity, rather than its total alone, change downstream recruitment.
A.operation: A prospectively specified sensory boundary with common basal conditions; compare selective DM1, multiglomerular shape at matched aggregate incremental rate per antenna, and a matched control over the same populations.
A.legal_information: Published receptor means, anatomical labels, antenna measurements, timing; no target-bearing or motor outcome used to choose input.
A.falsifier: Composition has no material downstream effect beyond matched quantity, or the interface/unknown antenna identities prevent an interpretable comparison.
A.limit: Rate scaling is an engineering intervention, not an identified chemical concentration; terminal laws must not silently differ between arms.

B.hypothesis: The current transfer law fails an independently measured sensory/circuit response despite matched input.
B.operation: Compare an identified input/output assay; change only a law contradicted by independent evidence and reserve an unused condition.
B.legal_information: Independent ORN/PN or descending-neuron measurements, without fitting locomotion.
B.falsifier: The current law predicts the independent response within frozen uncertainty, or a replacement fails the reserved condition.

C.hypothesis: An actual implementation or receptor/effector interface contradiction explains the observed transfer or loss of useful command.
C.operation: Inspect consumed boundary identities, units and ownership; repair only a demonstrated contradiction.
C.legal_information: Recorded operands, source contracts and mechanical controls already measured.
C.falsifier: Declared and consumed operations agree at the suspected boundary. No global audit or gain search follows an absence of contradiction.

stop: Deliver reproduced observations and a concrete next decision or exact prerequisite. Do not launch a new organism just because one input profile exists.
